businessGoal: Allow visitors to send inquiries or support messages through a contact form.

scenarios.goal: Verify that the contact form is accessible when navigating to the contact page.
Verify that all required fields are displayed in the contact form.
Verify that the subject dropdown contains the specified options.
Verify that a validation error is shown when the message is fewer than 50 characters.
Verify that a confirmation message is displayed after successfully submitting the contact form.

manual.reason: The story involves functional aspects of the contact form that can be manually tested.

api.reason: The story does not specify any API capabilities related to the contact form.

ui.reason: The acceptance criteria involve visible browser behavior and user interactions with the contact form.
